Messages.Author: Andy Berlett
Messages.Body:
My friend and I disagree over whether the Madness Network allows you to
take actions with all untapped Malk's you own or just one per player. We
couldn't be sure from the card text.

Does Weakness (and Meh'emet (sp?)) allow you to reduce capacity if the
victim has no Master Diciplines to burn?

Messages.Author: L. Scott Johnson
Messages.Body:
an...@vt.edu (Andy Berlett) writes:

>My friend and I disagree over whether the Madness Network allows you to
>take actions with all untapped Malk's you own or just one per player. We
>couldn't be sure from the card text.

All your untapped Malk's could take an action apiece:

Any untapped Malkavian may attempt an action.
After that action is resolved, any untapped Malkavian may attempt an action.
Repeat as necessary until no untapped Malkavians wish to take an action.

>Does Weakness (and Meh'emet (sp?)) allow you to reduce capacity if the
>victim has no Master Diciplines to burn?

No. If it did, then it would effectively reduce the capacity of a
victim who *did* have a Master Discipline by two (one for removing the
Discipline Card, and another by the secondary effect).
